source_analysis.reusable_architecture: Introduce a preservation or research problem, explain the method used to solve it, show how the resulting evidence becomes useful, and conclude with the wider significance of making previously inaccessible information available.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: Recovering sound from fragile wax cylinders through contact-free optical scanning
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Establish why historic cylinders are valuable but difficult to play; explain optical scanning and software reconstruction; describe cataloging and access; conclude that preservation can recover both sound and context.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: Studying charred fragments of ancient bread through microscopy and experimental baking
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Introduce overlooked food remains; explain laboratory identification; compare fragments with controlled replicas; connect preparation choices to social evidence; conclude that ordinary food can reveal past decisions.
